subject.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup

question: Should Ollama setup define five minutes without aggregate completed growth as a failed pull even when the server continues emitting status records or other bytes?
rationale: This is an intentional fail-closed compatibility policy rather than a mechanically provable timeout fix, and live multi-phase Ollama behavior was not exercised.

options.title: Approve semantic watchdog
options.body: Accept the 300-second completed-based rule as the supported setup contract, relying on the focused idle, drip, and advancing-progress coverage.

options.title: Confirm real phase behavior
options.body: Require proof from a real multi-layer Ollama pull or adjust the watchdog to recognize bounded meaningful phase transitions before merge.

recommendation.title: Confirm real phase behavior
recommendation.body: Require proof from a real multi-layer Ollama pull or adjust the watchdog to recognize bounded meaningful phase transitions before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects Peter Steinberger to the Ollama setup and bundled-plugin product boundary where this timeout contract belongs.
